metadata.title: Ironix — Offline Workout Tracker with a Muscle Recovery Map
metadata.description: Log every set in seconds, even with no signal, see which muscles are recovered and keep your gym pass on your phone. Free to use, in English and Arabic.

features.title: Everything you need at the gym
features.subtitle: A fast logger and honest progress data, built for people who lift.

1.title: Offline workout logger
1.description: Log sets, reps, weight and rest in seconds. Everything is saved on your phone first, so a dead zone at the gym never costs you a set.

2.title: Muscle recovery map
2.description: See which muscle groups you trained and how recovered they are before you plan your next session.

3.title: Digital gym pass
3.description: Scan your membership barcode or QR code once, then open it from the app or a home-screen widget.

4.title: Progress and records
4.description: Follow your volume, estimated one-rep max and personal records for every exercise.

5.title: 1,376 exercises and ready programs
5.description: Every exercise has an English and Arabic name. Start a ready-made program or build your own routine.

6.title: Import and backup
6.description: Bring your history from Strong or Hevy with a CSV file, and back up your workouts to your account.

howItWorks.title: Start training in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: From install to your first logged set in three steps.

1.title: Set your goal
1.description: Tell Ironix your goal, experience and training days. It takes about two minutes.

2.title: Log your workout
2.description: Pick a program or build your own routine, then log each set as you go, online or offline.

3.title: See your progress
3.description: Review your volume, records and muscle recovery to plan the next session.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: The core app is free, with no limits on logging, routines or history. Pro adds deeper analysis and personalization.

1.question: Does Ironix work without internet?
1.answer: Yes. Every set you log is saved on your phone first. When you are back online and signed in, it is backed up to your account.

2.question: Is Ironix free?
2.answer: Yes. Logging, routines, your full history, progress charts and personal records are free with no limits. Ironix Pro is an optional subscription for the muscle recovery map, advanced analytics, data export and extra themes.

3.question: Which phones does Ironix support?
3.answer: iPhone and Android. Ironix is launching soon, so join the waitlist to hear when it is available.

4.question: How does the digital gym pass work?
4.answer: Scan the barcode or QR code on your membership card once. Ironix keeps it on your phone so you can show it at the entrance, even offline.

5.question: Can I import my history from another app?
5.answer: Yes. You can import your workout history from Strong or Hevy using their CSV export.

6.question: What happens to my data?
6.answer: Your workouts belong to you. You can export them and delete your account at any time, which removes your data from our servers. The privacy policy explains the details.

footer.tagline: Train with purpose. Progress with proof.
footer.waitlistText: One email when Ironix launches. Nothing else.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy - Ironix
metadata.description: How Ironix collects, uses, shares and protects your personal data, and the choices and rights you have.

1.heading: Who we are and scope
1.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how Ironix ("Ironix", "we", "us") collects, uses, shares and protects personal data when you use the Ironix mobile app for Android and iOS (the "App"), visit this website (the "Website") or otherwise communicate with us. Together these are the "Services". Ironix also operates a web dashboard that is restricted to authorised staff and is not offered to the public.

Data controller. The Services are operated by [Legal entity name], registered at [Registered address], company registration number [Company registration number]. Unless this policy says otherwise, we are the controller of the personal data described here.

Data protection contact. [Data Protection Officer or EU/UK representative details, if applicable]. You can always reach us at {email}.

How the App works. Ironix is an offline-first fitness and workout-tracking app. Your data is stored on your device and is synced to our cloud backend only when you are signed in and have consented to sync. You can also use the App as a guest, without an account, in which case your data stays on your device.

2.heading: Information we collect
2.content:
2.1 Information you provide

• Account details: your name or display name, email address and a password if you sign up with email.
• Social sign-in: if you sign in with Google, Apple, Facebook, Kakao, WeChat, QQ, VK or Yandex, we receive the account identifier and the profile information you authorise that provider to share, typically your name, email address and profile picture.
• Profile and fitness details: profile photo (avatar), age, gender, height, weight and body-weight history, fitness goal, experience level and training frequency.
• Workout data: exercises, sets, reps, weight, RPE, duration and notes.
• Gym membership cards: card name, barcode data, and card image and colours.
• Body measurements, injury information, and progress-photo details (date, pose, weight and notes). The photo image itself stays on your device. This information is backed up to your account only if you turn on the body-data consent in the App; otherwise it stays on your device.
• Favourite exercises and the workout routines you create.
• Preferences: units, language, theme, notification settings and your consent choices.
• Communications: messages you send to us, for example to {email}.

2.2 Information created or collected automatically

• Derived data: experience points (XP), level, streaks, achievements, muscle-recovery statistics and personal records, calculated from your workouts.
• Analytics and diagnostics: product usage events (PostHog and Firebase Analytics) and crash reports with device and operating-system information (Firebase Crashlytics). These are subject to your consent where the law requires it (see section 3).
• Push notifications: a push token (Firebase Cloud Messaging or Apple Push Notification service) and your app user ID, stored on our servers so that we can deliver notifications to your device.
• Subscription status: purchase and entitlement information processed by RevenueCat and linked to your account ID. We never receive your payment card details.
• Sync information: technical records such as timestamps and deletion markers that keep your devices consistent.
• Website data: see section 11.

2.3 Information from third parties and optional integrations

The following apply only if you choose to enable or use them.

• Health Connect (Android) or Apple HealthKit (iOS): the App writes your workouts (type, start and end time, and notes) to the health store on your device.
• Strava: you link your Strava account through Strava's OAuth flow, and the token exchange is performed by an Ironix server function. What Strava receives and stores is governed by your Strava settings and Strava's privacy policy.
• Calendar sync: scheduled workouts are synced with Google Calendar or Apple Calendar.

2.4 Device permissions

Every permission is optional and is requested only when you use the related feature. You can change or withdraw a permission at any time in your device settings, although the related feature may then stop working.

• Camera: to scan gym-card barcodes and to take progress photos.
• Photo library: to choose avatar and gym-card images and to save summary images.
• Notifications: for workout reminders, streak alerts and campaign messages.
• Location: only if you use outdoor tracking or nearby-gym features.
• Bluetooth: to connect heart-rate monitors.
• Microphone: to record voice notes.

3.heading: How we use information and our legal bases
3.content:
We use personal data only for the purposes below. Where the EU or UK GDPR applies, we rely on the legal basis shown for each purpose.

• Providing the App: creating and managing your account, authenticating you, syncing your data between devices, managing your subscription status and giving support. Legal basis: performance of a contract (Article 6(1)(b)).
• Features you request: gym cards, reminders, and optional integrations such as Health Connect, HealthKit, Strava and calendar sync. Legal basis: performance of a contract and, where a feature depends on a device permission or a third-party connection you enable, your consent (Article 6(1)(a)).
• Product analytics and crash diagnostics: understanding how the App is used and fixing crashes. Legal basis: your consent where the law requires it, and otherwise our legitimate interest in keeping the App reliable and improving it (Article 6(1)(f)). You can opt out in the consent dialog or in Settings.
• Push notifications and campaign messages: your consent, which you can withdraw in your device or App settings.
• Health and fitness data: information such as body weight, measurements and injury information can reveal health details, which is a special category of personal data. We process it only on the basis of your explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a)), which you give when you choose to enter it or enable the related feature.
• Security, fraud prevention and abuse prevention, and enforcing our Terms: our legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)).
• Legal compliance: meeting legal obligations and responding to lawful requests from authorities (Article 6(1)(c)).

We do not sell your personal data and we do not use it to target advertising. We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

4.heading: Sharing and processors
4.content:
We share personal data only with service providers that help us operate the Services, with platforms you choose to connect, and where the law requires. We do not sell personal data, and we do not use third-party advertising SDKs to target ads. Our main recipients are:

• Supabase: hosted PostgreSQL database, authentication, storage and server functions (region eu-west-1, Ireland). Stores your account, profile, workout, sync and push-token data. Acts as our processor.
• RevenueCat: processes subscription purchase status. Receives your app user ID (your account ID) and purchase and entitlement data.
• PostHog: product analytics events, subject to consent where required.
• Google Firebase: Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics (crash reports and device and operating-system information) and Firebase Cloud Messaging (push delivery). Apple Push Notification service delivers push notifications on iOS.
• Apple App Store and Google Play: process purchases and subscriptions under their own terms and privacy policies. They act as independent controllers of your payment information, which we do not receive.
• Social sign-in providers (Google, Apple, Facebook, Kakao, WeChat, QQ, VK, Yandex): only the provider you choose to sign in with.
• Strava, Health Connect, Apple HealthKit, Google Calendar and Apple Calendar: only when you enable the integration. These platforms handle data under their own policies.
• Vercel: hosting of the Website.

Our authorised staff may access personal data through our restricted admin dashboard only as needed to operate the Services, provide support and keep them secure. We may also disclose information to comply with the law or a valid legal request, to protect the rights, safety and security of our users or the Services, or in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of assets, in which case we will ensure that this policy continues to protect your data or tell you of any change.

5.heading: International transfers and safeguards
5.content:
Our primary backend is hosted in the EU (Ireland). Some of our providers, such as RevenueCat, PostHog, Google, Vercel and Strava, may process data in the United States or other countries outside your own, where data protection laws may differ.

When we transfer personal data from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland to a country that has not received an adequacy decision, we rely on appropriate safeguards, in particular the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (together with the UK Addendum or International Data Transfer Agreement where applicable), or on the recipient's participation in a recognised framework such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. You can request information about these safeguards at {email}.

6.heading: Retention
6.content:
• Account life: we keep your account data for as long as your account exists. Guest data stays on your device until you delete the App or clear its data.
• Account deletion: you can delete your account in the App under Settings > Delete account. This deletes your account and all server-side data (profile, workouts, sets, gym cards, weight history, body measurements, injury information, progress-photo details, favourite exercises, your routines, gamification data, subscription record and push tokens) and clears local data on your device. Push tokens are removed when the account is deleted.
• Deletion markers (tombstones): when you delete a workout, measurement, injury, favourite exercise or routine, we keep a deletion marker for up to 180 days so that your other devices learn about the deletion, after which it is permanently purged.
• Backups: deleted data may remain in encrypted backups of our hosting provider for a limited period until they are overwritten. [Backup retention period].
• Analytics and diagnostics: retained for the period configured in each provider's account. [Analytics retention period].
• Support messages: kept for as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up.
• Third parties: data held by independent providers, such as app stores, Strava or health platforms, is retained under their own policies.

7.heading: Your rights
7.content:
Depending on where you live, you may have the following rights. We honour them for all users where reasonably possible.

If you are in the EEA, the United Kingdom or Switzerland:

• Access: get a copy of your personal data and information about how we use it.
• Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Erasure: have your data deleted.
• Portability: receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
• Restriction: ask us to limit how we use your data in certain cases.
• Objection: object to processing based on our legitimate interests.
• Withdraw consent: withdraw any consent you gave at any time, without affecting processing that took place before withdrawal.
• Complaint: lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.

If you are a California resident (CCPA/CPRA) or live in a US state with a similar law, you can request to know and access the personal information we hold, to delete it, to correct it, and to receive a portable copy. You also have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information (we do not sell or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising), to limit the use of sensitive personal information (we use it only to provide the Services you request), and not to be discriminated against for exercising your rights. The categories of personal information we collect are described in section 2: identifiers, health and fitness information, commercial (subscription) information, app activity, location where you use location features, and audio for voice notes. You may use an authorised agent to make a request.

How to exercise your rights. You can edit much of your data directly in the App, opt out of analytics in the consent dialog or Settings, and delete your account and server-side data in Settings > Delete account. For any other request, email {email}. We may need to verify your identity first. We respond within 30 days, and if we need more time where the law allows, we will tell you why.

8.heading: Health and fitness data notice
8.content:
Ironix is a tracking and motivation tool. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it is not a medical device. Please consult a qualified health professional before starting or changing an exercise programme.

Health-related information you give us, such as body weight, body measurements and injury information, is handled as sensitive data. We process it only with your consent, which you give when you choose to enter it or enable the related feature, and you can withdraw it by deleting the data or your account. We do not use health or fitness data for advertising, we do not sell it, and we do not share it with advertising platforms. Data written to Health Connect or Apple HealthKit is controlled by you through your device's health settings, where you can revoke access at any time.

9.heading: Security
9.content: We use technical and organisational measures designed to protect your personal data, including encrypted connections, authentication, row-level security that restricts each user to their own rows in our database, and restricted staff access to our admin dashboard. No system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please protect your password and your device. If a personal data breach affects you, we will notify you and the relevant authorities as required by law. To report a security concern, contact {email}.

10.heading: Children
10.content: The Services are not directed to children under 13, or under 16 in the EEA and the UK where the local age of digital consent requires it. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children below that age. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact {email} and we will delete it.

11.heading: Cookies and storage on the website
11.content:
The Website presents information about the App, download links and legal pages. It does not use advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, and we do not run third-party analytics on the Website. It stores only the following on your device:

• Language preference: a cookie named NEXT_LOCALE, kept for up to one year, set only when you choose a language or accept a suggested language change. It lets the Website open in your language.
• Theme preference: a local-storage entry named theme that remembers whether you chose light or dark mode. It stays until you clear your browser data.
• Language suggestion: a session-storage entry named ironix_geo_banner_dismissed that remembers you dismissed the language suggestion. It is removed when you close the browser tab or session.

These items are needed to provide features you request and contain no personal data beyond your preference, so the Website does not show a cookie banner. You can delete them at any time in your browser settings.

Server logs. Our hosting provider, Vercel, processes technical data such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you request in order to deliver and secure the Website. When you open the Website's root address, your approximate country (derived by the hosting network from your IP address) and your browser language are used momentarily to pick a language; we do not store them.

12.heading: Changes to this policy
12.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top shows when it last changed. If we make material changes, we will notify you in the App or on the Website before they take effect and, where the law requires, ask for your consent again.

13.heading: Contact
13.content:
For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, email {email}. For product help, email {email}.

[Legal entity name], [Registered address].

If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to complain to your local data protection supervisory authority.

metadata.title: Terms of Service - Ironix

1.heading: Acceptance and eligibility
1.content:

By downloading, installing, creating an account with or otherwise using the Services, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Services.

Eligibility. You must be at least 13 years old, or 16 in the EEA and the UK where the local age of digital consent requires it. If you are under the age of majority where you live, you must have your parent's or guardian's permission to use the Services, in particular before buying a subscription. Our admin dashboard is for authorised staff only.

2.heading: The service and accounts
2.content:
Ironix is a fitness and workout-tracking app. It lets you log workouts, follow your progress, store gym membership cards, earn gamification rewards and connect optional integrations. The App is offline-first: your data is stored on your device and is synced to our cloud backend only when you are signed in and have consented to sync.

Accounts. You can create an account with an email address and password, or sign in with a supported social provider (Google, Apple, Facebook, Kakao, WeChat, QQ, VK or Yandex). You can also use the App as a guest without an account. Guest data exists only on your device and is not backed up or synced, so it can be lost if you delete the App or lose the device.

You are responsible for providing accurate information, keeping your credentials secure and all activity under your account. Tell us promptly at {email} if you suspect unauthorised use.

We may add, change or remove features, and some features may be available only on certain platforms, in certain regions or with a paid subscription. Where practical, we will give reasonable notice of material changes that reduce the functionality you have paid for.

3.heading: Subscriptions, free trials, billing, cancellation and refunds
3.content:
Some features require a paid subscription ("Premium"). Subscriptions are purchased through the Apple App Store or Google Play (each a "Store") under the Store's terms. Ironix does not process your payment and does not receive your card details. RevenueCat processes purchase status for us.

• Prices and taxes: the price, currency and any taxes are shown by the Store before you buy. Prices are set by the Stores and can vary by country.
• Auto-renewal: subscriptions renew automatically for the same period at the then-current price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, or earlier if your Store requires it. Payment is charged to your Store account when you confirm the purchase and at each renewal.
• Free trials and introductory offers: where offered, the length and terms are shown before you sign up. Unless you cancel before the trial ends, you will be charged the subscription price.
• How to cancel: manage or cancel your subscription in your Store settings. On iOS: Settings > your name > Subscriptions. On Android: Google Play > profile icon > Payments and subscriptions > Subscriptions. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period, and you keep Premium access until then.
• Deleting the App or your Ironix account does not cancel a Store subscription. You must cancel it in the Store.
• Refunds: refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their refund policies, and you must request them from the relevant Store. We cannot refund Store purchases ourselves, but we will help with information you need.
• Price changes: the Store will notify you of price changes as its rules require, and you may cancel before they take effect.

Nothing in this section limits any mandatory consumer rights you have under applicable law, such as statutory rights of withdrawal, which the Store may apply on our behalf.

4.heading: User content and licence
4.content:
"Your Content" means the data you enter, upload or generate in the Services, including workouts, notes, gym-card data, photos and your avatar. You keep ownership of Your Content.

You grant Ironix a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce, process, sync and display Your Content solely to operate, secure and provide the Services to you, including syncing across your devices. This licence ends when Your Content is deleted, subject to the retention periods in our Privacy Policy, such as deletion markers kept for up to 180 days and limited backup retention.

You are responsible for Your Content and confirm that you have the rights needed to submit it, for example to gym-card images and photos, and that it does not infringe others' rights or break the law.

Licence to use the App. Subject to these Terms, we grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to use the App on devices you own or control, for your own non-commercial use, and in line with the Store's usage rules.

Feedback. If you send us ideas or suggestions, we may use them without obligation to you.

5.heading: Acceptable use

6.heading: Health disclaimer
6.content:
The Services are provided for general fitness tracking and information only. They do not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and Ironix is not a medical device. Nothing in the Services, including workout statistics, muscle-recovery estimates, and recommendations, replaces the advice of a qualified doctor or other health professional.

Consult your doctor before starting or changing any exercise, nutrition or training programme, especially if you have a medical condition, an injury, or are pregnant. Stop exercising and seek medical help if you feel pain, dizziness or unwell. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Exercise involves inherent risk of injury. You use the Services and take part in physical activity at your own risk and you assume all risks of injury to yourself. Calculations, estimates and suggestions may be inaccurate or incomplete, and you should not rely on them alone. Nothing in this section excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

7.heading: Third-party services
7.content: The Services work with third-party services, including the Apple App Store and Google Play, RevenueCat, Supabase, social sign-in providers, Health Connect and Apple HealthKit, Strava, Google Calendar and Apple Calendar, and Firebase and Apple push services. Those services are governed by their own terms and privacy policies, and we are not responsible for them. Integrations are optional and you can disconnect them at any time. Your use of a third-party service is at your own risk.

8.heading: Intellectual property
8.content: The Services, including the software, design, text, graphics, models and branding, and the Ironix name and logo, belong to Ironix or its licensors and are protected by intellectual-property laws. Except for the limited licence in section 4, these Terms do not transfer any rights to you. Open-source components are governed by their own licences. You may not use our name or marks without our written permission.

9.heading: Termination and account deletion
9.content:
You can stop using the Services at any time. You can delete your account in the App under Settings > Delete account. Deletion is permanent and removes your account and all server-side data (profile, workouts, sets, gym cards, weight history, body measurements, injury information, progress-photo details, favourite exercises, your routines, gamification data, subscription record and push tokens) and clears local data on your device. Deletion markers for your synced records (such as workouts, measurements and routines) are kept for up to 180 days so that your other devices learn of the deletion, then permanently purged, as described in our Privacy Policy. Deleting your account does not cancel a Store subscription.

We may suspend or terminate your access, with notice where practical, if you breach these Terms, if required by law, or to protect the security of the Services or other users. When these Terms end, your licence to use the App ends. Sections that by their nature should survive, such as sections 8 and 10 to 13, will continue to apply.

We do not warrant that the Services will be uninterrupted, error-free or secure, that syncing will always succeed, or that you will achieve any fitness result.
